Name OTTER (OTTER SDM, Optical Traffic Tracking Experiment for Responsive Space, MSAE-OTTERS)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status Operational? (No news or amateur receptions found, last checked 2025-12-24)
Launched 2025-11-28
NORAD ID 66678 
Deployer EXOpod Nova 12U/16U [Exolaunch]
Launcher Falcon 9 (Transporter-15)
Entity name DLR (German Aerospace Center)
Institution Space agency
Entity Government (Civil / Military)
Headquarters Germany
Manufacturer AIVT by German Orbital Systems
Operator German Orbital Systems
Partners DLR Competence Center for Responsive Space Cluster Compentence Center (RSC³)
Oneliner

Picks up AIS (Automatic Identification System) signals from co-operating ships and takes optical images of the transmitter area.
Description

Develop a small satellite within just nine months and start. For this, the typical development and provision processes need to be accelerated, from which future satellite developments should benefit.
